notes.title: Additional info
notes.text:
Workaround :
- Restricting access on tcp port 27918 prevents the issue.

FortiSIEM Cloud is NOT affected by this vulnerability.

remediations.details:
FortiSIEM 7.6: Not Applicable
FortiSIEM 7.5: Upgrade to 7.5.1 or above
